resources.string: "Swipe" for directional movement (hold for virtual joystick). "Tap" to confirm selection in menu or Pause one turn in-game (hold to Pause several turns in-game). "Double tap" to cancel or go back in menus (works like Escape key). "Pinch" to zoom in/out (in-game). Use hardware "Back" button to toggle virtual keyboard (hold to toggle keyboard shortcuts).

Some touch accessibility services can affect game gestures. Keep your screen reader enabled while testing the voice setup. Gameplay narration is still being developed. Continue to use the existing game controls, or open accessibility and voice setup:\n%1$s
The game did not quit properly last time
The crash report located in ./config/crash.log may help developers troubleshoot program errors.
The option you chose is not available.
The internal reader starts automatically when the game opens. Voice settings are optional. If speech is unavailable, keep TalkBack as a recovery option and select an installed Vietnamese voice.
Allow a voice that needs internet. The sample text may be sent online by the selected speech engine.
Voice settings changed. Listen to the selected voice before saving your new choice.
The internal reader starts automatically. You can change the voice here without first enabling the reader.
Preparing Vietnamese speech. This can take a few seconds.
The speech engine is ready. You can listen to the selected voice before saving.
Xin chào. Đây là câu thử giọng tiếng Việt của Cataclysm. Bạn có thể dừng lời đọc và quay lại bất cứ lúc nào.
Voice playback finished. If you did not hear it, check the volume and Android voice settings.
Speech stopped. No game action was performed.
The selected engine has no usable Vietnamese voice. Install or choose a Vietnamese voice in Android settings, then test again.
The selected voice needs internet. Choose an offline voice in Android settings, or explicitly allow a network voice for this test.
Speech could not start or failed. Turn on TalkBack or choose another voice in Android settings, then try again.
Android could not open settings. You can return to startup or open settings from your device.
Allow an online voice. Spoken text may be sent to the voice provider.
Installed voices are available. Listen to a sample before saving.
The selected voice is unavailable. Check the speech engine and language in Android settings.
Sample finished. Choose Save to apply the settings.
Listen to a successful sample before saving an enabled reader. To disable the reader, uncheck the top switch and save.
Volume is zero. Increase the volume before enabling spoken navigation.
TTS is on. Choose Listen to sample and Save to apply.
TTS is off in this draft. Saving will silence the in-game reader. Keep TalkBack available to enable it again.
